Also facades were a bit underwhelming, but maybe thats just because theres a lack of unique ones so far (and bafflingly the one they released works best with an ID who uses an EGO that replaces their appearance).
 I do hope that Season 8 will have a more focused story, and that the new auto-battler mode is more replayable than Mirror Dungeon (or that they at some point decide to make Mirror Dungeon better at being a Rogue-Like). Im quite excited. Oh, and I actually don't mind this between Season limbo, its nice to have a break, and to not be able to anticipate what IDs and EGO theyll release.

what really made both the season ids and the characters stand out is that they are all so unique and distinct which the last season rather struggled with. I really hope ids stay this way with more big named characters rather than the ids we got last season.

IDs and EGOs: I liked how, overall, there is a lot more diversity in team building; most archetypes have been brought to the same level (though that level is a bit high). There is also a good diversity of visuals, EGOs especially. The use of EGO to elevate older IDs (and vice versa) has been very interesting. Smaller nitpicks: visually, story-wise, and gameplay-wise, IDs have been a little too close to their counterparts. Some visual effects have been a little too much lately, obscuring the sprite animations, status effects on enemies have been especially intrusive.

Boss fights: I've really enjoyed this season's more puzzle-based approach to encounters, esp. Roach Emperor and Yinglong. I also really appreciate the revamped abnos (KQE and STNWC deserved it too!! and Centipede Apostle...). Music has also been great in elevating the experience (even if Yinglong didn't get its own :-( ). Flash Phenomenon was interesting, but deserved better.

Story-related: Canto and Intervallo were great, though a bit lacking in the Sinner interaction department. At times, it did feel like some important lines were cut, and the gaps forgotten. CGs also felt a bit poorly used. Flavour text is great, though a bit long in the latest IDs. Uptie stories have been fantastic, though as above, lean a bit too much into the reflected character and too little into the Sinner. I wish the abnos that we encountered had more story relevance instead of just being tools. The LCE logs were a great callback though (would love to see more, maybe N Corp. logs...? 👀).

Season structure: Incredibly packed season, I really appreciate PM's efforts here. QOL, smaller game updates, and UT5 have been great, made gap weeks much more interesting. Overall banner releases could have been better though (Index Don before Sora reveal, no standard fares, no anticipated seasonals for the last portion of the season).

I feel like Project Moon did in this season more than in any other season, close one being last season. Not talking about canto itself - Im still not sure if I like this more than Don's, but a lot of big updates with the biggest one being Refractial. Even if some could say their difficulty is underwhelming, it's still a good step in direction of more game modes.

Every other season only had mirror dungeon and for more invested players railway speedruns. Facades are also pretty cool as a fun fact - Mostly I dont care about grinding for them since I could grind for id's and ego's that I dont have, or maybe prep for future season, but free Meursault Facade is a good step of getting sinnerlings facades wich I WILL GRIND.

Story wise I feel like this season had the best intervalo's in the history of limbus (excluding spring cultivation, I doubt we will get anything like that soon wich is a shame). Twining Threads erased my doubts about canto IX and Mnestic Experience jumped over my expectations. I feel like we didnt get that good of a build up to canto since Warp Train and idea of Sancho sprinkled into our minds.

Gimmic of weakening final boss with cutting of Pupa's is dope and first fight where we get to choose weaknesses of out enemies is even more fun. Still, this is as close to perfect season as we gonna get, at least right now

The diversity of the new IDs has brought a lot to use in teams like envy-bleed, charge bleed, etc. One could say this was one of the most fun seasons to play in, with its many beautiful soundtracks, the much-needed updates and the main story of canto 9 which was incredibly interesting, showing a deeper part of Ryoshu's character we had yet to see. I feel like we are going to have an even better experience with canto 10 and season 8, and I can only hope that the director and Project Moon make the best decisions for the game's future.

I quite enjoyed RR6, despite struggling through it with my underleveled/non-cohesive teams; the gimmicks were fun to play around, and I enjoyed seeing the new Abnormalities. Also, the music (especially the battle themes) this Canto was amazing, and I'm glad they're implementing more QoL/cosmetic features.

I'm loving the rise of dual-status/tri-status teams, and the sheer variation of teams in general (i.e. being able to play Nursefather Rodion in a Thumb team, Burn team, or HoS one... as opposed to strictly encouraging her use in one team). Hopefully PM continues to iterate on game mechanics.

I do wish, however, that we'd revisit old factions/IDs, and add more Standard IDs and 2-stars instead of Seasonal 3-stars. (Dimension Shredder Yi Sang and Index Proxy Faust could've been Standard IDs instead of Seasonal ones, IMO.) I also hope we see more character development for Sinners whose Cantos have already released, to show how they've changed since.
